title: TC-JARVIS ledger projection
description: One-way projection of harness evidence into the TC-JARVIS ledger. The projection reports results; it never grants an admission. It carries no wall-clock timestamp: provenance is run_id plus source_commit, so identical inputs at one commit produce identical bytes. The ledger records receipt time downstream.

run_id.description: sha256(source_commit + sha256(canonical(validation)) + sha256(canonical(discovery))), where canonical() is UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(",", ":"). Inputs that differ only in key order or whitespace therefore share a run_id. Duplicate-suppression key only; never a cache key, because validation is time-dependent (180-day review expiry).

source_commit.description: Injected from git HEAD at projection time. Deliberately absent from the evidence files themselves so their byte determinism is preserved.

adapter_status.description: PASS: determined and clean; published, exit 0. FAIL: determined and not clean (registry invalid or scan incomplete); published so the ledger records the failure, exit 1, and retrying cannot change it. ERROR: could not determine (missing/unparseable input, adapter fault); nothing is published because no trustworthy document can be produced, exit 2, and retry may help.

registry_integrity.description: Aggregate validation status, forwarded verbatim. UNKNOWN only when validation-result could not be read. Never computed per record: the harness does not publish record-level status.

scan_integrity.description: Discovery scan_status, forwarded verbatim. When FAIL the candidate list is incomplete: an empty review_queue must not be read as clean.

admitted_sources.description: Authoritative records, projected from registry/oss-registry.json only. Sorted by id.

id.description: Copied verbatim from jarvis_ledger.ledger_id. Never derived from admission_id and never minted.

admission_status.description: Registry status, forwarded verbatim. The adapter never produces this value from a discovery observation.

review_queue.description: Non-authoritative observations, projected from evidence/discovery-result.json only. These are NOT ledger records: no id and no admission_status may appear here, which additionalProperties:false enforces. Sorted by candidate_id.

candidate_id.description: Queue-local identifier. Never promoted to a ledger id.

discovery_status.description: An observation, deliberately in a different field from admission_status. ADMITTED_MATCH means 'matches an approved record', not 'is approved'.

source_record_id.description: Set only when discovery_status is ADMITTED_MATCH; null otherwise. Never invented.

errors.description: Masked before projection: absolute paths reduced to a basename, URL userinfo stripped, known credential prefixes redacted. Sorted.
